message: Build hello.py, a single-file Python standard-library CLI. Accept no arguments and print exactly one line, the text in quotes with no trailing period: "hello world, I'm Seldon". Usage errors (including unknown flags and wrong argument count) exit 2, emit a nonempty diagnostic on stderr and no stdout. Successful runs exit 0 with no stderr. Use UTF-8 text.

profile.platform: Windows, Python 3 standard library; desktop and mobile browser
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network assets, deployment or paid services.
